thread:
samir: starting canary 2.11.1 -> us-central (10%). quick FYI: change touches batching logic for generation.
emily: saw a deploybot note about p95 jump on gen route. how big?
deploybot: ALERT: gen-route p95 +22% over baseline (4m). Auto-rollback criteria: p95 >=25% OR errors >=0.5% sustained 5m. Current: p95 +22% (4m), errors 0.07%.
ops-oncall: were close to auto threshold. Because this is a customer-facing generation route in a peak window i'd prefer manual decision to avoid flip-flopping. Manual-rollback authority held by ops.
samir: i'm going to apply a manual hold and kick off quick repro. If it stabilizes in 6m we can proceed; else rollback.
deploybot: ACTION: canary hold applied by samir. Traffic frozen at 10%. Auto-rollback remains ENABLED.
pm_ron: product note: can we add a short line to release notes about potential p95 variance for generation batching changes? want cs to have a heads up.
kate: drafting release-note addendum now. also running targeted perf runners with slow-path prompts.
emily: running offline 20m regression run (est 18m). will post results.
(6m)
emily: offline shows p95 +24% on the slow-path prompts (20m window) and repro looks tied to a new batch-coalescing path.
ops-oncall: given labs + live signal, approve manual rollback to 2.11.0 for canary slice only. Keep global at 2.11.1 for non-reserved pools. Samir, please execute rollback and ops will prepare comms.
samir: executing `/deploy rollback --to 2.11.0 --region=us-central --slice=canary --graceful=true` now.
deploybot: ROLLBACK STARTED by samir. Graceful drain in progress; estimate ~3m.
pm_ron: kate, please make the release notes note: "Generation batching optimization temporarily regresses tail latency on certain slow-path prompts; rolling back canary while fix is validated." Keep wording non-technical for customers.
kate: pushed note and queued CS email draft. Legal reviewed language.
(3m)
deploybot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE. Canary reverted to 2.11.0. Metrics: gen-route p95 back to baseline, errors unchanged.
ops-oncall: filing INC-2245 and assigning postmortem to samir+kate. We'll delay reattempt until batch coalescing fixes landed and additional canary probes added.
emily: opening issue with repro steps and perf traces. cc: kernel-team.
samir: thanks team. closing hold. ops will monitor for 24h. If anything customer-facing emerges, ping #customer-notify and i'll join the bridge. :thumbsup:
